karty.priklad_cs: The sky is blue today (glas → [l]as after yn).
karty.mnemo: OUR (AWYR) sky at sunset glows ruby red.

karty.priklad: Af i i Gaeredin yr wythnos nesa.
karty.priklad_cs: I'll go to Edinburgh next week (Caeredin → [G]aeredin after i).
karty.mnemo: caer = fortress + Edin(burgh): a red kite circles the castle on the rock.

karty.priklad_cs: They'll go to Rome tomorrow (Rhufain → [R]ufain after i).

karty.priklad: Mae'r ganolfan yn bwysig i'r gymuned.
karty.priklad_cs: The centre is important to the community (cymuned → [g]ymuned after 'r, feminine).
karty.mnemo: COMMUNITY ≈ CYMUNED: the whole community gathers round a red-hot barbecue.
A GIRAFFE (GYR-fa) in red lipstick climbs the career ladder.

karty.priklad_cs: The fire engine will come in a minute.
karty.mnemo: injan = engine, tân = fire (→ dân after the feminine injan): a fire engine, red of course.

karty.priklad: Mae rhaw gyda fi yn y garej.
karty.priklad_cs: I've got a spade in the garage.
karty.mnemo: 'OW!' (RHAW) – somebody left the spade in the forge and it's glowing red.

sever.priklad: Mae gen i raw yn y garej.
sever.priklad_cs: I've got a spade in the garage (rhaw → [r]aw after gen i).
sever.pozn: north: Mae gen i + soft mutation instead of Mae … gyda fi (L6)

karty.priklad_cs: As long as there's no emergency tonight!
karty.mnemo: 'ARGH, GUV!' (AR-GYF-wng) – an emergency on a motorway covered in black ice.
bad = boat, achub = to save: a lifeboat ploughs through freezing grey-blue waves.

karty.priklad: Mae ei fusnes e'n mynd yn dda.
karty.priklad_cs: His business is going well (busnes → [f]usnes after ei = his).
karty.mnemo: Same as English: his business sells snowballs, and it's booming.

sever.priklad: Mae ei fusnes o'n mynd yn dda.
sever.priklad_cs: His business is going well (busnes → [f]usnes after ei = his).

karty.mnemo: 'COME – OR THaw!' (CYM-ORTH): a mountain rescuer brings help to a climber frozen to a ledge.

karty.priklad: Mae diogelwch y plant yn bwysig iawn.
karty.priklad_cs: The children's safety is very important (pwysig → [b]wysig after yn).
karty.mnemo: diogel (safe) + -wch: safety first – the climbers are roped together on a frozen waterfall.

karty.priklad: Siaradiff y perchennog â chi yfory.
karty.priklad_cs: The owner will speak to you tomorrow.
karty.mnemo: The owner sits on his PERCH (PERCH-ennog) like a parrot, frozen blue to the spot.

karty.priklad: Gorffennwn ni'r project yr wythnos nesa.
karty.priklad_cs: We'll finish the project next week.
karty.mnemo: Same as English: a science project on how fast an ice cube melts.

karty.priklad_cs: Ffion will organise an important committee meeting (pwyllgor → [b]wyllgor as the object after the verb form).
karty.mnemo: pwyll = good sense: the committee meets in an ice hotel to keep cool heads.

karty.priklad: Mae'r plant yn cadw sŵn ofnadwy.
karty.priklad_cs: The children are making an awful noise.
karty.mnemo: SOON (SŴN) you'll hear the noise – the frozen lake is cracking.

karty.priklad: Ffonia i'r swyddog iechyd a diogelwch.
karty.priklad_cs: I'll phone the health and safety officer.
karty.mnemo: swydd (job, office) + -og: an officer guarding a snow-covered sentry box.
